WEB TECHNOLOGY MICRO HANDBOOK
Unit-wise Important Questions + 2 Marks + 6 Marks + Diagrams + Repeated Questions

UNIT 3
2 Marks: Servlet, XML, DTD, AJAX, Cookie, URL Rewriting, doGet, doPost
6 Marks: Servlet Life Cycle, Servlet Architecture, AJAX, XML DTD, Session Management.
Diagram: Load -> init() -> service() -> destroy()
Repeated: Servlet Life Cycle, AJAX, XML DTD, doGet vs doPost
UNIT 4
2 Marks: JSP, SOAP, WSDL, MVC, Struts, Action, Interceptor
6 Marks: JSP Life Cycle, JSP vs Servlet, MVC, SOAP, WSDL, Struts.
Diagram: User -> Controller -> Model -> View
Repeated: JSP Life Cycle, SOAP, WSDL, MVC
UNIT 5
2 Marks: PHP, Node.js, ASP.NET, WAP, WML, Array
6 Marks: PHP Arrays, MySQL Connection, WAP Architecture, $this Keyword
Diagram: WAE -> WSP -> WTP -> WTLS -> WDP
Repeated: Arrays, WAP Architecture
UNIT 6
2 Marks: EJB, Rails, Ruby, Stateless, Stateful, Singleton
6 Marks: EJB Architecture, Types of EJB, Rails, Ruby Scalar Types
Diagram: Client -> EJB Container -> Bean -> Database
Repeated: EJB Types, Rails Advantages

MOST IMPORTANT FOR EXAM
1. Servlet Life Cycle
2. AJAX
3. JSP Life Cycle
4. MVC Architecture
5. SOAP & WSDL
6. PHP Arrays
7. WAP Architecture
8. EJB Types
